title: The Business Central 2026 release wave 2 docs nobody asked for ..
summary: Waldo created an interactive navigation tool for the Business Central 2026 Wave 2 release event videos, mapping 319 features across 38 videos with direct timestamps to help users find specific announcements without watching all 7+ hours. The site uses AI to extract features and quotes from auto-captions and cross-references them with official documentation to highlight gaps or conflicts.
key_points: 319 features identified from 38 videos (7 hours 9 minutes) with developer tools receiving 89 minutes of airtime
Interactive zoomable wheel organizes features by 10 functional areas, with clickable timestamps linking to exact seconds in YouTube videos
Discovered 22 documented features not shown in videos and 178 shown but not documented, plus 46 status conflicts between video announcements and official docs
Site built using AI to process 68,000 words of YouTube captions, extract features and quotes, and create a searchable index across all videos
features: transfer wip item and wip ledger entry in subcontracting

quotes.text: I let a bunch of agents watch the whole thing for me.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the practical use of AI agents to process and structure large volumes of video content automatically.

quotes.text: Think of it as a table of contents for 7 hours of video. An index. A map.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the tool's purpose as a navigation aid to the source videos rather than a replacement for official documentation.

quotes.text: Every single thing on the site exists to get you to the right video, at the right second, as fast as possible.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core design philosophy of optimizing user navigation to specific content rather than consuming full-length videos.
